items.name: Cold Cheese Slice
items.look_text: A slice of cheese so cold it has stopped being food and started being evidence.

items.name: Crumpled Birthday Card
items.look_text: "Happy 2nd Birthday Dorko — 07/14." Someone crumpled this on purpose. Probably me.

items.name: Bread
items.look_text: Two slices traveling as one item. They've agreed to this.

items.name: "Meat"
items.look_text: The label just says 'meat' in quotes. The quotes are doing a lot of work.

items.name: Sliced "Meat"
items.look_text: Sliced. The quotes survived the knife.

items.name: Lettuce
items.look_text: Crisp. Green. The only thing in this house with its life together.

items.name: Good Sandwich
items.look_text: Meat and cheese. Now we're cooking. We're not cooking. It's cold.

items.name: Great Sandwich
items.look_text: Meat, cheese, lettuce. A complete thought.

items.name: Ramune Bottle
items.look_text: Full. The marble stares back. It's seen the inside of the bottle its whole life.

items.name: Cassette Tape
items.look_text: Hand-labeled: 'sounds (mine)'. The tape is wound to somewhere in the middle of something.

items.name: Plastic Trophy
items.look_text: PARTICIPANT. No year, no event. Just the concept.

items.name: Wet Rag
items.look_text: Dripping with confidence. And water. Mostly water.

items.name: Wind-Up Key
items.look_text: A key for winding something up. Or, in one recent case, for stopping that.

combinations.line: Assembly complete. It's a sandwich. Legally.
Toasted. The crunch will mean something to someone.
Upgraded. The cheese is still cold. That's the risk it carries.
A great sandwich. I almost don't want to give this away. Almost.
